construction.method: AREX scope/ground/construct/verify and repository evidence/usability methods adapted to InferRSI native owners and packaging; no DisCo runtime or managed import.

applicability.scope: Pinned Flare complete-session restore and admission audit for its NVIDIA SM120/SM121 research prototype. CUDA catalog scope is content classification, not device or backend qualification.

limitations: Source-only candidate; native Flare/model/GPU/service and skill efficacy were not evaluated.
GDS/Direct transport is deferred and explicitly rejected by the pinned implementation.
Multi-rank source branches do not establish multi-GPU, multi-host or hardware failure qualification.
Root Apache-2.0 attribution does not grant model, asset or separately licensed dependency rights.
Only the selected symbols/sections were inspected; kernels, exporter implementation and whole-repository behavior are outside coverage.
